why: ChatGPT's answer is one camera: its cards are all standalone SPYPOINT FLEX models with a free 100-photos-a-month plan, and it names no accessory the shopper must add, since the SD card is only overflow storage and a SIM card is just an alternative path. What decides the purchase is whether a camera's free plan is permanent or a trial, and whether it accepts a prepaid SIM, which is a comparison between single models rather than a set of items.
